segments.t: As the draft officers escort a stunned Aleksandr away to serve in the army, Lyova happily takes back his sous-chef title and reinstates Max as a line cook. Meanwhile at the hospital, supplier Timur barges loudly into the ward and ruins Viktor Petrovich's latest attempt at playing weak for Elena.
Саша, иди на свое рабочее место.
Виктор Петрович не пришел в себя.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'The question is, how did they track him down?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'question' and finishing on 'found'. Vika answers right away.
'Devil only knows.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'darn' and 'what' in a few short words.
'By his last name, probably.' The meaning hinges on 'on' working together with 'probably' in spoken Russian.
'No, you will not do that, right?' The grammar packs 'there is no' and 'yes' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Vika answers right away.
'You will not, all right then.' The grammar packs 'not' and 'really?!' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'You are a line cook again.' Sasha brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'again' in a few short words.
Саша, иди на свое рабочее место.
'Sasha, go back to your workstation.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Sasha' before landing on 'station'. Vika answers right away.
'Do you think I am constantly lying?' In Russian, the idea of 'think' flows naturally into 'lie' without extra filler words.
'Oh, not at all!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'you'.
'Hello, my angel, Viktor...' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'hello' and 'angel' in a few short words. Vika answers right away.
'Quiet, quiet, Timur.' The meaning hinges on 'easy' working together with 'Timur' in spoken Russian.
Виктор Петрович не пришел в себя.
'Viktor Petrovich has not regained consciousness yet.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Viktor' and 'yourself' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Could you please not shout in here?' Chef Viktor raises the pitch on 'here' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Саша, иди на свое рабочее место.
Виктор Петрович не пришел в себя.
